verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents multiple fast-integration checkout paths (Hosted Payment Page, Payment Links, Drop-in Element, quickstart) that a founder could plausibly wire up quickly, and sandbox signup is self-serve/instant. However, there's no evidence on actual account verification/KYB turnaround time for production activation, which is the real bottleneck for 'accepting a real card payment within a day' — docs only cover sandbox/testing speed, not production onboarding SLAs. missing for 10: documented KYB/underwriting approval time, evidence of same-day production activation, independent founder testimonials confirming day-one live payment acceptance.
